Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Lipscomb
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 140 as introduced clarifies the calculation of taxable income for credit unions under the Alabama financial institution excise tax law. Otherwise, this bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

Committee: Banking and Insurance
Sponsor: Lipscomb
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/10/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 140 as passed the House of Representatives clarifies the calculation of taxable income for credit unions under the Alabama financial institution excise tax law. Otherwise, this bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Shay Shelnutt, Chairperson
Banking and Insurance
